_about: Public-domain Milton Valentine, Lutheran theologian, president of Pennsylvania College at Gettysburg and professor in the Gettysburg seminary, for the Word Hoard: Christian Theology, Natural Theology, Theoretical Ethics, and The Essential Principles of the Lutheran Church. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 129 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

valentine-essential-principles: The essential principle of reform (Gettysburg, Aughinbaugh & Wible, book & job printers, 1865)
valentine-natural-theology: Natural theology; or, Rational theism (Chicago, John C. Buckbee & co, [c18)
